entities.summary: Alexis Ganay Peterson is an American-German basketball combo guard who last played for Beşiktaş of the Turkish Super League. A former ACC Player of the Year at Syracuse, she was drafted by the Seattle Storm with the 15th overall pick of the 2017 WNBA draft. She played for the German national basketball team at the 2024 Olympics in Paris.
